mapping_schema.candidate_domain_ids: One or more subject-domain IDs from the matching taxonomy version.
mapping_schema.candidate_category_ids: One or more leaf category IDs; candidate discovery only.
mapping_schema.mapping_confidence: high, medium or low confidence in the product-level assignment, not confidence in dataset availability.
mapping_schema.mapping_basis: Inventory fields used for the assignment.
mapping_schema.uncertainty: Human-readable limit on the mapping inference.
mapping_schema.planned_lane: Dependency/readiness lane; not a connection or ingestion state.
mapping_schema.inventory_access_snapshot: Research-time access, cost, reuse, evidence and blocker fields copied without upgrading their evidence state.

interpretation: Every mapping is a candidate product-level discovery assignment. It does not claim complete category coverage, a tested connection, an admitted dataset, successful ingestion, historical completeness, or publication.
Category coverage becomes operational only through a versioned dataset contract with verified access, rights, grain, history, loading and modeling fields.
Additional candidates are outside the 182-source inventory and remain untested; they do not change inventory counts.

coverage_gaps.gap: No candidate establishes store/SKU/channel-level Poland FMCG sales, volumes, distribution or market share.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Assess licensed retail panels only after a concrete business use case and budget; do not purchase during discovery.

coverage_gaps.gap: Personal care, household cleaning/paper and pet-care coverage is limited to possible production/trade classifications, not consumer markets.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Enumerate PKWiU/CPA/HS/CN product families and identify lawful retail or household-expenditure distributions.

coverage_gaps.gap: The 182-source inventory has no dedicated cross-sport fixtures, results, athlete or ranking provider.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Start with official federations for priority sports; verify distribution and reuse per federation.

coverage_gaps.gap: Polish club/federation participation tables are not a dedicated inventory product, and local facilities/funding remain sparse.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Contract the GUS physical-culture series, then inspect Ministry and municipality registers by sport and geography.

coverage_gaps.gap: Public/platform APIs do not provide a complete comparable Polish cross-media audience and advertising market series.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Separate regulatory/public indicators from licensed measurement panels and document allowed aggregates.

coverage_gaps.gap: Postal, parcel, courier, warehousing and commercial logistics markets are underrepresented.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Add an explicit postal/parcel/logistics taxonomy category before contracting UKE postal and transport statistics.

coverage_gaps.gap: Municipal/county catalogues, BIP documents, budgets, planning and service operators are represented by examples rather than a national enumeration.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Use versioned TERYT units to maintain publisher-discovery status without indiscriminate crawling.

coverage_gaps.gap: Open administrative health data does not establish private-provider, device, pharmacy retail or full pharmaceutical-market coverage.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Prioritize official product/facility registers and aggregate reimbursement; defer commercial panels.

coverage_gaps.gap: Listings reports do not establish transaction prices, rents, commercial property, land or full historical Poland market coverage.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Inspect official transaction/valuation aggregates and licensed products with redistribution terms.

coverage_gaps.gap: Metals, soft commodities, freight derivatives and carbon allowances lack a consistent worldwide market-data candidate set.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Identify official venue/agency distributions; keep paid terminals conditional.

coverage_gaps.gap: Detailed film, music, games, publishing, ticketing and collection metadata coverage is uneven.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Enumerate public institution datasets and separate copyrighted works from metadata and aggregate market measures.

coverage_gaps.gap: No dedicated vulnerability, incident, threat or cyber-capacity source is inventoried.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Research official CERT Polska, ENISA and global standards-based feeds with redistribution constraints.

coverage_gaps.gap: Defence, foreign affairs and development-aid aggregates are sparse.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Use official budget, procurement and international reporting only at lawful aggregate/document level.

coverage_gaps.gap: Waste, recycling, material-flow and circular-economy sources are mostly embedded in broad statistical portals.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Enumerate Eurostat/GUS datasets and Polish regulator/municipal registers with classification and facility keys.

coverage_gaps.gap: District heat, water supply, wastewater, distribution outages and local tariff/service quality are sparse.
coverage_gaps.next_evidence: Identify regulator and municipal-utility datasets; keep customer-level records out of open intake.
